description: Image Description: The image shows the rear end of a motorcycle. The motorcycle has a glossy black paint finish with blue flame-like decals. The license plate is partially pixelated to obscure the numbers, but the text "MINNESOTA" and "FEB M.C." is visible. The motorcycle features a wide rear tire and a sleek fender above it.
